EC1: Cases of rectal tumours [OR] below 12cm from anal verge, or locally advanced tumours invading blood vessels [OR], nerves [OR] or bone.
EC2: Multiple bone metastasis [OR] or central nervous system metastasis
EC3: Other neoplastic disease in the 5 previous years, [NOT] except squamous [OR] or basal cell skin carcinoma [OR] or cervical "in situ" carcinoma
EC4: Significant heart disease [OR] (chronic congestive heart failure [OR], symptomatic coronary disease) or myocardial infarction in the previous 6 months
EC6: Patients who do not give informed consent
